description: OS/390 + z/OS COBOL programs with VSAM/IMS/DB2 I/O, CICS transaction control, and COPYBOOK record layouts. Calibrated against banking, insurance, and government batch corpora.

claimKinds.label: Invariant
claimKinds.description: Behavioural invariants the program / section must preserve. Includes paragraph-fall-through semantics where relevant.

fields.name: generatorHints
fields.doc: Optional. Per-claim Hypothesis-style generator hints (per ADR-030). Shape: { inputs:[{name,type,min?,max?,maxLen?,alphabet?}], constraint?:string, examples?:[{...}] }. When present, the 4th validation gate (FALSIFYING) exercises the claim against generated inputs; when absent, the gate skips the claim with skipReason: no_hints.

claimKinds.label: Section contract
claimKinds.description: Per-PARAGRAPH or per-SECTION input/output contract. COBOL paragraphs lean heavily on shared WORKING-STORAGE, so the section contract captures what was assumed in vs. what was assumed out.

claimKinds.label: I/O side effect
claimKinds.description: VSAM / IMS / DB2 / CICS calls and their semantics. Each call is one IO-* claim, citing the verb and the file/cursor it touches.

claimKinds.label: Edge case
claimKinds.description: Common COBOL pitfalls: ON SIZE ERROR, INVALID KEY, AT END, EVALUATE WHEN OTHER, fall-through paragraph entry.

fields.name: generatorHints
fields.doc: Optional. Per-claim Hypothesis-style generator hints (per ADR-030). Same shape as on invariant. When present, the 4th gate exercises this edge case against generated inputs that satisfy the hint constraint; when absent, the gate skips the claim with skipReason: no_hints.

claimKinds.label: Open question
claimKinds.description: Ambiguities — typically around copybook field-layout variants, REDEFINES interpretations, or undocumented PERFORM THRU spans.

promptHints.emphasis: COBOL semantics depend on PROCEDURE DIVISION fall-through. Always cite the entry section/paragraph and any PERFORM THRU span that includes the cited code.

platformReadiness: Schema is platform-ready (loaded + listed). Prompts (#3b) and target-stack archetype (#3c) need authoring per engagement.
